authority: User-authorized 29 October finite exploration; 27 October assumptions override conflicting earlier input gates
interpretation: Post-hoc exploratory analysis motivated by completed 26 October DW. This is not an untouched confirmatory test or a p<0.05 search.

shared_rules.corpus: Frozen title/name/no-GAZ Gemma; reuse deduplicated representatives and existing S for monthly branches
shared_rules.security_scope: Retain v2 unique static issuer, explicit Russian corporate equity/debt, identity/residence/mandate/report-quality and scheduled maturity screens
shared_rules.source_dates: Actual dates only; do not move 29 May to calendar month end
shared_rules.monthly_panel: Reuse v2 immutable fund_security_panel.parquet without rebuilding historical pipeline
shared_rules.inference: Existing absorbed OLS, iterative singleton pruning, two-way fund/company CGM CR1 with full FE rank, t df=min clusters-1; no PSD clipping; invalid variances remain missing
shared_rules.null_cases: No news/error/irrelevant not neutral; missing prices not zero; missing quantities not fabricated
shared_rules.reporting: All selected models including NOT_ESTIMABLE, sample flow, N/funds/companies/securities/period/FE/clusters/beta/SE/95%CI/p/withinR2; generated-regressor/LLM uncertainty remains conditional

price_rules.quote: Observed positive CLOSE, no price interpolation or future quote
price_rules.endpoint: Last observed quote on or before actual endpoint, maximum 7 calendar days old
price_rules.series: Use the same ISIN/SECID/BOARDID series at both endpoints; prefer recorded primary board, then highest opening-date trading VALUE, deterministic identifiers as ties
price_rules.currency: RUB/RUR/SUR only, including nonmissing bond FACEUNIT; no foreign FX assumption
price_rules.shares: CLOSE per share; no invented split adjustment
price_rules.bonds: CLOSE/100 times positive historical FACEVALUE; do not invent missing face values; retain known scheduled maturity screen. This is clean-price revaluation, not total return
price_rules.relative_proxy: log(reported_value_close/reported_value_open)-log(price_close/price_open), continuing strictly positive positions only. Not directly observed quantity; comparability/accrual/split/coupon limitations explicit
price_rules.full_portfolio: All positive opening exposures >1e-12 must have supported price return or documented RUB cash/deposit assumption. Reconciliation tolerance 1e-8; unknown residual not zero; no covered-subportfolio renormalization
price_rules.cash: Identified RUB idle cash interest 0; identified RUB deposit with no disclosed income 0; explicit disclosed income not overridden; unidentified/noncash/FX exposures remain uncovered
price_rules.coverage: Show excluded rows and opening weight at every step; no threshold grid or outlier-driven exclusions

models.purpose: One exact numerical reference replication, not rerun of source preparation

tests: derived equity and bond directional slopes
models.purpose: Formal heterogeneity, not compare subset significance
Relative allocation within the same fund/date interval; fund-level expansion shocks absorbed

models.sample: Exactly the continuing positive positions with accepted quote pairs used by M3

models.purpose: Implied-quantity/value-growth proxy, not full-portfolio AT or observed quantities

models.sample: Adjacent actual reconciled complete nonpassive reports; closing date 2018-01-01 through 2026-05-29; no calendar-EOM/consecutive-month requirement
models.news: Current (start,end], lag (start-duration,start]; complete classification; company and closing-month FE, lag Tone, log1p relevant counts, 3 source shares and log duration; minima six usable unique windows/company, ten companies/closing month; residual / sample SD

models.sample: Monthly panel restricted to whole opening portfolios fully covered under documented user assumptions
models.conditional: Report NOT_ESTIMABLE if full denominator coverage or rank insufficient
Only actual source quantity and unit fields independently confirmed; otherwise no regression, retain entry/exit descriptive counts

Actual fund unit-value/return history, exact fund-series identity, adequate 36 prior observations in 60-month window and already available appropriate factors. Preserve original alpha estimand; no short-history fit or simple return renamed alpha
models.fallback: NOT_ESTIMABLE with exact observed source limit

multiplicity.within_family: For every fixed model, include the two target coefficient two-sided p-values, directional intersection-union p and absolute-asymmetry p as one declared family set; asset family includes two interactions, joint Wald, derived four subgroup coefficients. Report all raw and Holm p; unavailable tests count as p=1 in the predeclared family size
multiplicity.across_families: Exploratory conclusions only; no selective claim that one significant family confirms original H1-H3

power.method: Approximate minimum detectable effect at 80% and 90% power using (t_0.975,cluster_df+z_power)*conditional cluster SE; no observed posthoc power
power.units: basis points of weight per one-unit standardized S

prohibited: No mutation of protected data, live Gemma, frozen R1 or completed prior runs
No automatic confirmation from subgroup significance
iterations: One feasibility inventory, one source-price extraction, one bounded estimation pass; only genuine implementation errors justify repairs
